frictions.description: The R process was dead (SIGTERM) when the browser session started, despite the task description stating the server was running with a fresh bayesgrove project. The 'Retry' and 'Refresh connection' GUI buttons did not restart the R process — they only retry the WebSocket connection to the backend.
frictions.resolution: Attempted Retry button (3 times), Refresh connection button, page reload, and 'Use default workflow' button. None restarted the R process. Per AGENTS.md rules, did not attempt to restart services or modify shared infrastructure.

blockers.description: R child process is dead (received SIGTERM). The Bun backend on port 3100 is healthy (HTTP 200), but the R process that provides the bayesgrove session is not running. No Rscript process found on the system. The GUI shows 'Session unavailable' with reason 'r_process_exit:null:SIGTERM'. Without an active R session, cannot add/delete nodes or interact with the REPL.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Clicked Retry button (3 times over 45 seconds), clicked Refresh connection, reloaded page, clicked 'Use default workflow' button. Checked with `ps aux | grep Rscript` — no R process found. Verified backend health with curl — returns 200. Per AGENTS.md rules, did not attempt to restart the server or R process directly.

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 1 passed (VAL-GUI-010: error state visibility confirmed with rose overlay and status banner), 4 blocked (VAL-GUI-008, VAL-GUI-009, VAL-GUI-011, VAL-GUI-012: R process dead with SIGTERM, cannot add/delete nodes without active R session). The Bun backend is healthy but its R child process was killed before testing began. GUI recovery mechanisms (Retry, Refresh) only retry WebSocket connections and do not restart the R process.
